method: Prompt changed only to add the alt_text instruction (inserted between the caption and photo_category instructions) — the caption instruction itself and players[]/quality/visible_text instructions are byte-for-byte unchanged from the prior ADR 0006 receipt. Verified this holds the caption's own contract: ran the real, updated prompt through the live gemini-2.5-flash-lite model on 10 real, previously-unprocessed DWdCET (Milliken at North Central) photos (DSC09426, 09427, 09430, 09432, 09434, 09435, 09437, 09438, 09440, 09441), no database write, and read each of the 10 source images directly to check the caption against it. 10/10 passed inspectCaption (0 issues) — no relationship/emotion/outcome/aesthetic/swimwear claims, all under 30 words. Coverage: 8 of 10 named at least one jersey number (consistent with ADR 0006's v2 prompt). Two defects observed and left recorded, both pre-existing vision-model limitations independent of this change: DSC09426's caption misreads jersey #11 as #17 (a number-legibility error, not a contract violation); DSC09432, 09435, and 09437 mislabel the action verb (serve vs. set vs. spike vs. attack) despite correctly reading colors, numbers, and scene.
scope: 10 DWdCET/Milliken photos, real model, no DB write
